title: Your first month studying abroad, by element
caption:
New city, new course, and a fridge with nothing in it. Here's how each element handles the first month abroad.

Air joins six societies in week one. Fire has a bank account and a part-time job by day four. Water makes mum's dal (after three phone calls). Earth is quietly homesick, and top of the class anyway.

The useful bit is on slide 6. Send this to someone who's just moved for uni.
